title: Dóru color theme

$schema.description: Reference to the theme schema; enables autocompletion and validation in editors that understand JSON Schema.

name.description: Display name. Falls back to the file name (the theme id).

dark.description: CSS custom-property values: every key becomes --doru-<key> in the app stylesheet. Values may be any CSS value (hex, rgb(), gradients, …). See the theme guide for the standard variables.

light.description: CSS custom-property values: every key becomes --doru-<key> in the app stylesheet. Values may be any CSS value (hex, rgb(), gradients, …). See the theme guide for the standard variables.

description: A Dóru theme: one palette file with a dark and a light section. The operating system appearance decides which palette applies. The file name (without the .json extension) is the theme id.
